declarations.name: RICH_TEXT_FORMATS
declarations.description: The formats `formats` can list, in their default toolbar order.

A compact formatted-text field for comments, replies, email bodies and short descriptions: bold, italic, underline,
strikethrough, inline code, links, bulleted and numbered lists, quotes and code blocks, and nothing more. For long
documents with headings, tables, colours and images, use `c2-page-editor`.

The toolbar is one tab stop (arrow keys move between its buttons, Alt+F10 reaches it from the text, Escape goes
back), sits at the top, at the bottom beside the app's own buttons, over the selection, or nowhere
(`toolbar-position`), and moves the buttons that do not fit into a "More" menu. `formats` chooses the buttons, their
order and groups, and is also what the keyboard shortcuts, the Markdown typed as you go (`- `, `1. `, `> `,
three backticks, `**bold**`; Backspace right after undoes it) and paste are allowed to produce: anything else
pasted becomes plain text, and pasted styles (Google Docs, Word) become the formats they show.

Tab leaves the field, except in a list or a code block, where it indents; Escape there gives Tab back, so the
next one leaves. ⌘/Ctrl+Enter fires `submit`, which submits an enclosing form unless it is cancelled.

The value is GitHub-flavoured Markdown (`<u>` for underline), the same as `c2-page-editor`'s, and is `''` when the
field is empty. `toHTML()` gives the HTML for an email body: `p`, `br`, `strong`, `em`, `u`, `s`, `code`, `pre`,
`a`, `ul`, `ol`, `li` and `blockquote`, with links limited to web, mail and phone addresses. The element is a form
control (`name`, `required`, `maxlength`, reset, disabled fieldsets) and takes its label, hint and error from an
enclosing `c2-form-field`.

Mentions, tags and emoji are the app's: list trigger characters in `triggers` (`"@ #"`), listen for `trigger` to
draw a picker under `detail.rect` from `detail.query`, and call `completeTrigger(text, { href })` with the choice.
While a trigger is active, a capture-phase `keydown` listener on the element that calls `preventDefault()` keeps
the key (ArrowDown, Enter) from the text.

cssProperties.description: A focus ring around the whole field, e.g. `0 0 0 3px rgba(2, 101, 220, 0.15)`.
cssProperties.name: --c2-rich-text-editor__container__focus--box-shadow

cssProperties.description: While invalid: over `maxlength`, or an enclosing `c2-form-field` shows an error.
cssProperties.name: --c2-rich-text-editor__container__error--border

cssProperties.description: The line between the toolbar and the text (above it when the toolbar is at the bottom).
cssProperties.name: --c2-rich-text-editor__toolbar--border

cssProperties.description: Width and height of a toolbar button; at least 44px on touch screens.
cssProperties.name: --c2-rich-text-editor__tool--size

cssProperties.description: The text grows from this height…
cssProperties.name: --c2-rich-text-editor__content--min-height

cssProperties.description: Space between paragraphs, lists, quotes and code blocks.
cssProperties.name: --c2-rich-text-editor__block--margin-top

cssProperties.description: Indentation of one list level, which is also the width of the marker column.
cssProperties.name: --c2-rich-text-editor__item--indent
--c2-rich-text-editor__code--font-family
cssProperties.default: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

cssProperties.description: The link popover and the floating toolbar.
cssProperties.name: --c2-rich-text-editor__popover--background

cssParts.description: The box around the toolbar, the text and the footer.
cssParts.name: container

cssParts.description: The row under the text holding the footer slots and the counter.
cssParts.name: footer

cssParts.description: The popover that edits a link.
cssParts.name: link-popover

slots.description: The app's own tools at the end of the toolbar (attach, mention, emoji). Each is a tab stop of its own.
slots.name: toolbar-end

slots.description: Content at the start of the footer, such as a Send button. With `toolbar-position="bottom"` the toolbar follows it.
slots.name: footer-start

slots.description: Content at the end of the footer, after the character counter, such as Cancel and Comment buttons.
slots.name: footer-end

members.name: value
members.description: Markdown. `''` when the field is empty.

members.name: name
members.description: Name of the field in form data.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name when the field is not inside a `c2-form-field` and has no `aria-label`.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Shown while the field is empty.

members.name: formats
members.description:
Space-separated formats the writer may use, in toolbar order, `|` starting a new group: `bold italic underline
strike code link bullet ordered quote code-block`. Shortcuts, typed Markdown and paste produce only these. Empty
allows all.

members.name: toolbarPosition
members.description: Where the toolbar sits: `top`, `bottom` (in the footer, after `footer-start`), `floating` (over selected text; at the bottom on touch screens) or `none`.

members.name: triggers
members.description: Space-separated characters that start a `trigger` when typed at the start of a word, e.g. `"@ #"`.

members.name: readOnly
members.description: Selectable and focusable, without a toolbar; the value is still submitted.

members.name: maxLength
members.description: Most characters of text (not Markdown) the field accepts: past it, a counter turns red and the field is invalid. `-1` for no limit.

type.text: { char: string; query: string; from: number } | null

members.name: labels
members.description: Labels associated with this form control.

members.name: text
members.description: The text without formatting, one block per line.

members.name: currentFormat
members.description: The block and the formats at the selection.

members.name: position
members.description: Where the toolbar is drawn: nowhere while read-only, at the bottom for a floating one on a touch screen.

members.name: focus
members.description: Focuses the text.

members.name: isDirty
members.description: Whether the writer has edited the text since the last reset.

members.name: reset
members.description: Restores the `value` attribute.

members.name: setCustomValidity
members.description: Sets or clears a custom validation message.

members.name: toggleMark
members.description: Toggles bold, italic, underline, strikethrough or inline code on the selection, or on what is typed next.

members.name: setBlock
members.description: Turns the blocks at the selection into `block`. Returns whether anything was applied.

members.name: setLink
members.description: Links the selection (or the link at the caret) to `href`, or removes the link with `null`. Unsafe addresses (`javascript:`) are refused.

members.name: clearFormatting
members.description: Removes every inline format and link from the selection.

members.name: insertText
members.description: Inserts plain text at the caret, replacing the selection.

members.name: completeTrigger
members.description:
Replaces the active trigger (`@mai`) with `text` and a space, linked to `href` when one is given. Returns false
when no trigger is active.

members.name: toHTML
members.description: The text as HTML (`p`, `strong`, `em`, `u`, `s`, `code`, `pre`, `a`, `ul`, `ol`, `li`, `blockquote`, `br`), for an email body or a page.

members.name: markCommand
members.description: The shortcut of a format that is not allowed (or in code) still takes the key, so the browser does not apply its own.

members.name: restrictedDoc
members.description: A value read as a document, with what `formats` does not allow turned into text.

members.name: restrict
members.description:
Blocks and marks `formats` does not allow become text: headings and to-dos become lines (to-dos bullets, when
those are allowed), a table its rows, a code block its lines; dividers and images go. Colours never come in.

members.name: syncSelectionFromDom
members.description:
ProseMirror learns where a click put the caret from `selectionchange`, which the browser fires asynchronously. A
key pressed before it arrives would run against the old selection, so read the real one first.

members.name: domSelection

type.text: { anchorNode: Node; anchorOffset: number; focusNode: Node; focusOffset: number } | null

members.description:
The caret and selection inside the shadow root: `getComposedRanges` where the browser has it, whose `direction`
tells the anchor from the focus, else the shadow root's own `getSelection()`.

members.name: measureToolbar
members.description: Moves the tools that do not fit on one line into the "More" menu.

members.name: stopNativeEditing
members.description: Stops the editing surface's own `input` / `beforeinput`: the element fires its own `input` with `value` up to date.

events.name: input
events.description: Fired on each edit, after `value` is updated.

events.name: format-change
events.description: Fired when the block or the formatting at the selection changes. Does not bubble.

events.name: trigger
events.description: A character listed in `triggers` was typed at the start of a word, the word after it changed, or it ended (`active: false`). Does not bubble.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when the field loses focus after its value changed.
⌘/Ctrl+Enter was pressed. Cancelable: unless it is cancelled, an enclosing form is submitted. Does not bubble.
events.name: submit
